analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest ever quarterly revenue in Q2 FY27 with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax, alongside maintained elevated gross margin spreads. Management highlighted that operations were impacted by geopolitical tensions in West Asia and flooding at the Silvassa unit, which caused a one-time inventory and operational loss. Domestic volumes registered healthy growth while export volumes moderated due to logistics and shipping disruptions in the Middle East. The company remains focused on disciplined working capital management, expanding high value-added products, and strengthening customer relationships. Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest-ever quarterly performance for Q2 FY27 with revenue of ₹1,847 crore, driven by strong growth across segments and sustained gross margin spreads.

guidance.claim: Management expects interest costs to improve slightly in the next two quarters as SOFR rates have softened.
guidance.quote: SOFR has softened, although the spreads have gone up, but we expect interest cost to improve slightly in the next 2 quarters.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of the margins remaining at or around current levels for the whole year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% or up to 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and export sales will remain at the same level for the quarters to come.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates the margins would continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
guidance.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.
demand_outlook.quote: However, demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.

demand_outlook.claim: The process and insulating oil business continued to deliver a very strong performance driven by healthy demand from transformers, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was driven by healthy demand from the transformers, power and the rubber industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Export volume moderated during the quarter primarily due to geopolitical developments in West Asia and impacts on shipping and logistics.
demand_outlook.quote: However, export volume had moderated during this quarter, primarily due to the geopolitical developments in West Asia and the impact on the shipping and logistics.

demand_outlook.claim: There continues to be a gap between the demand and the supply of base oil due to refinery closures and vessel disruptions.
demand_outlook.quote: So, there continues to be a gap between the demand and the supply.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that base oil pricing will be on the higher side with elevated pricing of crude.
demand_outlook.quote: With the elevated pricing of crude, we anticipate the base oil pricing also will be on the higher side.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continued to see strong traction in process and insulating oils, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business delivered a robust performance supported by healthy demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that the trends and growth in the PHPO and process and insulating oil divisions will continue to be similar for the next quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: So, these are the two segments where we anticipate the growth will be similar. The trend will continue to be similar for the next quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Global industry reports estimate the specialty oils industry to grow at more than 5% CAGR globally.
demand_outlook.quote: See, if you look at the CRISIL report, which we did 1.5 years back, the industry is supposed to grow at more than 5% CAGR globally.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.

capex_expansion.claim: The total installed capacity stands at 838,000, representing an enhancement of 240,000 over the existing capacity due to capitalization of capital WIP over the last few quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: the total installed capacity now stands at 838,000 which is an enhancement of 240,000 over the existing capacity of 5,98,000, which is basically on account of the capitalization over the last few quarters of the capital WIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Investments for capacity enhancement were done from IPO proceeds and internal accruals and transferred from CWIP to fixed assets.
capex_expansion.quote: So, apart from debottlenecking, there were investments which were done from the IPO proceeds and also from some internal accruals, for which Mr. Indrajit has informed, it has been transferred from CWIP to the fixed assets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter which strengthened operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin for the quarter stood at 21% with a gross margin spread of approximately INR29,128 per kl.
margins_costs.quote: The gross profit stood at INR388 crores compared with INR130 crores in Q2 FY '26 with a gross margin of 21%. The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26 and INR28,000 per kl in Q1 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss and exceptional item of approximately INR21 crores.
margins_costs.quote: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss of approximately INR21 crores. As this is a onetime event, we have presented it as an exceptional item.

margins_costs.claim: Employee expenses included a one-time ex gratia payment of INR15 crores to INR16 crores paid across the board.
margins_costs.quote: There is a INR15 crores -- INR16 crores ex gratia which has been paid across the board to everybody.

margins_costs.claim: Insurance rates have gone up and war risk premiums have been added for vessels coming out of Hormuz.
margins_costs.quote:
So, we have not seen so much but only the war risk premium has been added from especially the vessels coming out of the Hormuz.
Indrajit Bhattacharyya: Insurance rates have gone up ma'am.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin Spread was sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, which is 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: • Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x year-on-year to INR 28,145 per kilolitre.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 206 crores, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin for the quarter on a consolidated level was 21.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization on a stand-alone level is 82% to be precise.
orders_capacity.quote: So, I can tell you currently, currently the utilization on stand-alone level is 80%, 82% to be precise.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the consolidated level is around 61%.
orders_capacity.quote: The consol level, it is around 61%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization across all 3 plants taken together is around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

capital_allocation.claim: The stand-alone company remains debt-free as of date.
capital_allocation.quote: The stand-alone company remains debt-free as of date.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated borrowings reduced to about INR85 crores as on September 30, 2026, from INR168 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated borrowings which relate mainly to trade finance and borrowings at our overseas Texol level reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September '26 from INR168 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: The reaffirmation of credit ratings by CRISIL and enhancement of rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore strengthen financial flexibility.
capital_allocation.quote: The reaffirmation of our credit ratings by CRISIL and enhancement of our rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore further strengthen our financial flexibility.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of the shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The stand-alone company is effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at overseas subsidiary Texol.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has decided to use about INR 20 crores of the quarter's performance for the payment of an interim dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, we have decided to use about INR20 crores of this for payment of interim dividend.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment continued to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in West Asia and disruptions to global shipping routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter continues to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in the West Asia and disruptions to the global shipping routes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Base oil availability and prices remained uncertain, and freight and insurance costs continued to affect supply chain planning.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our key raw material base oil availability and prices remain uncertain and freight and insurance costs continue to affect supply chain planning.

risks_headwinds.claim: Silvassa unit 2 was affected by heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July, leading to cleaning, special repair work, and temporary suspension of operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: As shared earlier, our Silvassa unit 2 was affected by a heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July this year. Our priority was to carry out required cleaning, special repair work and restart operations safely.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at the Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was challenged by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in crude oil and base oil pricing, and intermittent supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: During period Q1, operations at subsidiary Texol in Hamriyah Free Zone, Sharjah, were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and vessel movement disruptions arising from the geopolitical situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on strengthening customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics in the PHPO segment.
management_commitments.quote: The PHPO continues to be our largest and the most important product category, and we remain focused on strengthening our customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on serving international customers and capturing long-term growth opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: While the near-term condition remains challenging, exports continue to be an important part of the business, and we remain focused on serving our international customers and capturing long-term growth opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management will continue to focus on expanding the customer base, strengthening existing relationships, and improving the product mix in the lubricant business.
management_commitments.quote: We view this sequential improvement positively and we will continue to focus on expanding our customer base, strengthening existing relationships and improving our product mix to support our future growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management priorities remain to deepen presence across segments, expand into new geographies, move into higher value chain, and expand capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Moving ahead, our priorities remain clear: deepen our presence across segments, expand into new geographies, move into higher value chain and expand capacity.

management_commitments.claim: Capital allocation priorities remain focused on funding growth capex largely through internal accruals and maintaining a prudent balance sheet.
management_commitments.quote: Our priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding presence across geographies, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at or around current levels for the whole year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates the export revenue and export sales will remain at the same level for the quarters to come.
management_commitments.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates margins will continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Clarity on the strategy and specific plans for the South African arm will emerge in the next 1 or 2 odd quarters.
management_commitments.quote: There will be much more clarity being emerging in the next 1 or 2-odd quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
